name: WPA Knowledge Connected Vessels Integration

core_model.institutional_dna: What institutions demonstrably do in practice.
core_model.scholarly_dna: What books, papers, articles, theses, reports, standards and other scholarly evidence support, challenge, refine or explain.
core_model.wpa_synthesis: Compare the two evidence streams, preserve disagreement, and route validated knowledge to every eligible WPA domain under provenance and Human Gate controls.

doctrine_rule: External scholarly evidence may support, refine, challenge or trigger review of WPA doctrine. It may never autonomously rewrite the Doctrine Kernel. Any doctrinal change is an HG4 human-authority event.
strategy_rule: WPA strategy should explicitly distinguish evidence-supported convergence, unresolved conflict, institutional-practice signals without scholarly confirmation, and scholarly findings not yet observed in institutional practice.
research_rule: Agents should not merely collect publications. They should extract source-traceable research questions, methods, findings, limitations, contradictions and strategic relevance into Scholarly Knowledge Atoms.
rights_rule: Discovery is not permission to ingest. Open, public-domain, open-license or manually authorised material may be used according to its rights. Restricted/paywalled/login-based sources remain external discovery/manual-verification surfaces unless lawful access and reuse permission are separately established.
agent_operating_cycle: Discover legally accessible scholarly and institutional evidence
Create Practice Atoms and/or Scholarly Knowledge Atoms
Map relation to WPA doctrine, methodology and strategy
Route approved atoms to eligible WPA systems
Measure downstream usefulness and error/correction signals
Propagate corrections and reintegrate verified lessons
anti_drift_invariants: No source-free synthesis may be presented as verified evidence.
No single publication or institution may silently redefine WPA doctrine or methodology.
No citation-count, follower-count, national prestige or platform popularity proxy may replace evidence quality.
No protected full text may be copied into WPA merely because it is discoverable.
No contradiction is erased merely to produce a cleaner narrative.
Every consequential downstream use must be traceable back to its knowledge atom and source identity.

24_7_ready.rule: The architecture is ready for scheduled proactive operation, but continuous execution must not be claimed until scheduler/source adapters are technically activated and independently verified.

public_principle: WPA does not collect knowledge for storage alone. Verified knowledge is routed, tested, applied, measured, corrected and returned to the Institute as governed institutional learning.
